desc: BLOCKED until 206/210 gives a non-asserting NVMe path. Then complete the storage milestone on internal storage: (1) mount /dev/nvme0n1p3 exFAT, write a file, fsync, reboot, verify; (2) raw dd soak to /dev/nvme0n1p3 ONLY with md5 verify. CJ authorized 2026-08-02: writes via the mounted filesystem AND raw writes to p3 only -- NEVER raw writes to /dev/nvme0n1 or any APFS partition. Compare throughput against the SD card (58.2 GiB SDXC, already working) so we know what NVMe actually buys.
author: claude
